Usage: hops fg create [OPTIONS] NAME

  Register a new feature group in the feature store.

  Args:     ctx: Click context.     name: Feature group name.     version:
  Version; auto-assigned when omitted.     primary_key: Comma-separated
  primary keys.     features_spec: Comma-separated ``name:type[:description]``
  items.     event_time: Event-time column name.     partition_key: Comma-
  separated partition keys.     online: Whether to enable the online store.
  embedding_spec: ``col:dim[:metric]`` for a vector feature.     description:
  Free-form description.

Options:
  --version INTEGER       Feature group version; backend auto-assigns if
                          omitted.
  --primary-key TEXT      Comma-separated primary-key column names.
  --features TEXT         Comma-separated schema "name:type[:description]",
                          e.g. "id:bigint:User id,amount:double".
  --event-time TEXT       Name of the event-time column.
  --partition-key TEXT    Comma-separated partition column names.
  --online                Enable the online feature store.
  --embedding TEXT        Embedding feature spec, "col:dim[:metric]". Auto-
                          enables online.
  --description TEXT      Free-form description.
  --json / --no-json      Force JSON / force human tables (default: JSON when
                          piped).
  --verify / --no-verify  Verify the Hopsworks TLS certificate; --no-verify
                          skips verification for self-signed / IP-SAN-
                          mismatched certs.
  -h, --help              Show this message and exit.

Usage: hops fg insert [OPTIONS] NAME

  Insert rows into a feature group from a file, stdin, or synthetic data.

  Args:     ctx: Click context.     name: Feature group name.     version:
  Feature group version.     file_path: CSV or JSON file path. When omitted,
  read JSON from stdin.     generate: Generate N synthetic rows instead.
  online: When True, pass ``start_offline_materialization=False``.

Options:
  --version INTEGER       Feature group version; defaults to latest.
  --file PATH             CSV or JSON file to load.
  --generate INTEGER      Generate N rows of synthetic data and insert.
  --online                Write to online store only (skip offline backfill).
  --json / --no-json      Force JSON / force human tables (default: JSON when
                          piped).
  --verify / --no-verify  Verify the Hopsworks TLS certificate; --no-verify
                          skips verification for self-signed / IP-SAN-
                          mismatched certs.
  -h, --help              Show this message and exit.

## Summary

I completed the task entirely through the Hopsworks CLI (`hops`):

1. **Created the feature group** `profilesb0e43f` v1 with record key `account_id`, features `f1`–`f4` (double), and `--online` to enable low-latency access.
